notes: The chapter's decision on WLC.EZK.35.12.v002 (r00-base, covering s018) is carried in the projection and is compatible with the ASV's *They are laid desolate*; no rule 53 case arises.
The first margin (*that I am Jehovah; I have heard*) would make s005 a copular predicate taking a supplied *am*; the ASV's text as printed writes no copula, so s005 takes only *Jehovah*.
שָׁמֵמוּ → *They are laid desolate* heads on the complement *desolate* by rule 44's subtraction test; the dative לְ is silenced by the bare indirect object *us* (rule 40).
